title: Everyday Phrases — A Pottery Class
title_quote: Are these tables only for clay?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏺 實用「陶藝課」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Pottery Class
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「陶藝課」情境對話，共 800 句、400 組短句（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。從選泥巴、學搓圓、坐上拉坯機，到手一歪就塌了、捏一個小杯子、刻上自己名字、挑釉的顏色，最後兩週後去取件，八個場景一路聽下去。每句 3 到 9 個字，A2 生活口語，不用背、不用看螢幕，躺下來循環聽 800 句就能記住。適合英語初學者、ESL 學員、想睡前複習英文的大人。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features 800 practical A Pottery Class phrases in 400 pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Eight scenes run in order: choosing clay and an apron, rolling the clay round, sitting down at the wheel, watching it collapse, pinching a small cup, carving your own name, picking the glaze color, and coming back for your piece two weeks later. Every line is 3 to 9 words at CEFR A2 level, so you just lie down and let the 800-sentence loop do the work. Great for beginners, ESL learners, and anyone reviewing English before bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these tables only for clay?
dialogue.zh: 這些桌子只拿來放泥巴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set your bag under the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɛt jʊr bæɡ ˈʌndər ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 對，把包包放在架子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign something before class?
dialogue.zh: 上課前我要簽什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just write your name on this sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst raɪt jʊr neɪm ɑn ðɪs ʃiːt/
dialogue.zh: 在這張表上寫名字就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sheet is signed already.
dialogue.zh: 表格我已經簽好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the clay bin is over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðə kleɪ bɪn ɪz ˈoʊvər ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，泥巴桶就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which clay should I pick up?
dialogue.zh: 我該拿哪一種泥巴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the brown stoneware, please.
dialogue.zh: 先從褐色耐熱土開始吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is brown clay softer than gray?
dialogue.zh: 褐色泥比灰色軟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it gives under your palm.
dialogue.zh: 對，手掌一壓就凹下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This gray bag looks very dry.
dialogue.zh: 這袋灰色泥看起來好乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it and press the lump.
dialogue.zh: 打開來，按一塊看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pounds is plenty for me.
dialogue.zh: 兩磅對我來說就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pounds, then; trimming takes some.
dialogue.zh: 那就兩磅，之後修坯會切掉一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for the clay today?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ fɔr ðə kleɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 泥巴的錢今天要付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the desk takes cards after class.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə dɛsk teɪks kɑrdz ˈæftər klæs/
dialogue.zh: 不用，下課後櫃台可以刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card is easier, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得刷卡比較方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk takes cards near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk teɪks kɑrdz nɪr ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台就在門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have a plastic apron?
dialogue.zh: 有一件塑膠圍裙可以借我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one hangs behind you.
dialogue.zh: 藍色那件就掛在你後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine ties at the neck.
dialogue.zh: 我這件是掛脖子的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it low, so your shirt stays dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ɪt loʊ soʊ jʊr ʃɜrt steɪz draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 繫低一點，襯衫就不會濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This knot is too tight.
dialogue.zh: 這個結太緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the string, not the cloth.
dialogue.zh: 拉帶子就好，別扯布料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sleeves are already covered.
dialogue.zh: 我的袖子已經包住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll them up past the elbow.
dialogue.zh: 再捲到手肘以上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put my phone?
dialogue.zh: 手機要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lockers line the left wall.
dialogue.zh: 左邊牆有一排置物櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number seven is free.
dialogue.zh: 七號剛好空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put your coat inside it.
dialogue.zh: 外套直接放進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these paper towels strong enough?
dialogue.zh: 這些紙巾夠結實嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, take the cloth roll instead.
dialogue.zh: 不，改拿那捲布毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands get very muddy.
dialogue.zh: 我的手會弄得超髒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse them before you touch your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ðɛm bɪˈfɔr ju tʌtʃ jʊr feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 碰臉之前先把手沖一沖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the washing sink?
dialogue.zh: 洗手的水槽在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back corner, beside the big bin.
dialogue.zh: 後面角落，大桶旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only cold water from the tap.
dialogue.zh: 水龍頭只有冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm water is in that kettle.
dialogue.zh: 溫水在那個壺裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bucket for rinsing, right?
dialogue.zh: 一個水桶用來洗工具，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, clean water and dirty water.
dialogue.zh: 兩個，清水和髒水要分開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dirty water goes far from the clay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɜrti ˈwɔtər ɡoʊz fɑr frʌm ðə kleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 髒水要離泥巴遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. The last class made a mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə læst klæs meɪd ə mɛs/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，上一班弄得滿地都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Table four is mine today.
dialogue.zh: 今天我用四號桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, it sits near the window.
dialogue.zh: 很好，那張就在窗邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunlight dries the clay too fast.
dialogue.zh: 陽光會讓泥巴乾得太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the blind down a little.
dialogue.zh: 把窗簾拉下來一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cord feels stiff.
dialogue.zh: 這條繩好硬，拉不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull slowly, it gives way.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢拉，它就會動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need our own tools?
dialogue.zh: 我們要自備工具嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Studio tools are in that tray.
dialogue.zh: 工作室的工具在那個托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wooden rib and a wire, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwʊdən rɪb ænd ə ˈwaɪər ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那要一根木刮片和一條割泥線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both cut the clay clean.
dialogue.zh: 對，兩者都能割得很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose sponge is this, so wet?
dialogue.zh: 這塊海綿是誰的，好濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine, I keep it in water.
dialogue.zh: 我的，我都泡在水裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I borrow it for a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈbɑroʊ ɪt fɔr ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以借我一下下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, rinse it before you give it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr rɪns ɪt bɪˈfɔr ju ɡɪv ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 可以，還我之前先沖乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your apron has a big pocket.
dialogue.zh: 你的圍裙有個大口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good for nails and hair ties.
dialogue.zh: 放指甲刀和髮圈剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair keeps falling down.
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮一直往下掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it back, clay sticks to everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ɪt bæk kleɪ stɪks tu ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 綁起來吧，泥巴什麼都黏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nails short too, I guess.
dialogue.zh: 指甲也要剪短才對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long nails scratch the wet pot.
dialogue.zh: 長指甲會在濕坯上刮出痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes? These are already muddy.
dialogue.zh: 鞋子？這雙已經全是泥了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rubber soles grip the wet floor.
dialogue.zh: 橡膠底在濕地板上比較抓得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor is slippery here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的地板很滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with that old towel.
dialogue.zh: 用那條舊毛巾擦一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room smells like rain.
dialogue.zh: 這個房間聞起來像下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Damp earth, nothing else, I love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæmp ɜrθ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls aɪ lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是潮濕的泥土味，我超愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music or silence while we work?
dialogue.zh: 做的時候聽音樂還是安靜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft music, but tell me if it is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ˈmjuːzɪk bʌt tɛl mi ɪf ɪt ɪz laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 輕音樂，太吵的話跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it down, please, a bit.
dialogue.zh: 請轉小聲一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better? Now let us find your clay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər naʊ lɛt ʌs faɪnd jʊr kleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好點了嗎？現在來挑你的泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bag is heavy for one arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bæɡ ɪz ˈhɛvi fɔr wʌn ɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 這一袋單手拿太重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the cart, wheels by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə kɑrt wilz baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 用手推車，輪子就在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cart loaded, now where do I sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrt ˈloʊdɪd naʊ wɛr du aɪ sɪt/
dialogue.zh: 車裝好了，那我坐哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any stool, the class starts at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni stuːl ðə klæs stɑrts æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 任一張矮凳，六點上課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six sharp, so no being late.
dialogue.zh: 六點整，不能遲到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doors lock after the first demo.
dialogue.zh: 第一次示範結束後門就鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Demo? What happens in the demo?
dialogue.zh: 示範？示範的時候會做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The teacher shows wedging on table one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtitʃər ʃoʊz ˈwɛdʒɪŋ ɑn ˈteɪbəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 老師在一號桌示範揉泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wedging, why do we push it?
dialogue.zh: 揉泥為什麼要一直往下壓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To drive out air, or the pot cracks.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu draɪv aʊt ɛr ɔr ðə pɑt kræks/
dialogue.zh: 把空氣擠出來，不然坯會裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Air bubbles ruin everything.
dialogue.zh: 氣泡會毀掉整件作品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small ones only spoil the look.
dialogue.zh: 小氣泡只影響外觀而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spoil the look? Not the firing?
dialogue.zh: 只影響外觀？不影響燒製嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big holes split in the kiln, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ hoʊlz splɪt ɪn ðə kɪln jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 大洞進窯會炸開，會的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kiln? So the oven comes later.
dialogue.zh: 窯？所以燒製還排在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We send work to a shared kiln.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛnd wɜrk tu ə ʃɛrd kɪln/
dialogue.zh: 我們把作品送到共用的窯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shared kiln, so my pot waits a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛrd kɪln soʊ maɪ pɑt weɪts ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 共用窯，所以我的坯要等一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks, and only if it dries well.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiks ænd ˈoʊnli ɪf ɪt draɪz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 兩週，而且要乾得均勻才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks feels a long time.
dialogue.zh: 兩週感覺好漫長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patience is half the craft, friend.
dialogue.zh: 耐心是手藝的一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friend? I know nobody here.
dialogue.zh: 朋友？我在這裡不認識任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will, after one shared collapse.
dialogue.zh: 會的，一起看坯塌一次就熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Collapse? Did mine already fall?
dialogue.zh: 塌？我的已經垮掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but keep both elbows in.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt bʌt kip boʊθ ˈɛlboʊz ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，但手肘要收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elbows in, noted on my hand.
dialogue.zh: 手肘收著，我記在手背上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nervous? Everyone is on lesson one.
dialogue.zh: 緊張嗎？大家都才第一課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lesson one starts with the clay.
dialogue.zh: 第一課從認識泥巴開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And ends with very dirty shoes.
dialogue.zh: 然後以一雙超髒的鞋子收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First exercise: a round ball.
dialogue.zh: 第一個練習：搓一顆圓球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round means no corners, no flats.
dialogue.zh: 圓就是沒有角，也沒有平面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine looks like a potato.
dialogue.zh: 我這顆看起來像馬鈴薯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Potatoes have ends; circle it more.
dialogue.zh: 馬鈴薯有兩頭，再多繞幾圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Circle it? On the table?
dialogue.zh: 繞圈？就在桌子上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, roll it against the board.
dialogue.zh: 對，在泥板上來回推著搓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both hands, one direction, then switch.
dialogue.zh: 兩手同方向滾，然後換邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, switching keeps it even.
dialogue.zh: 很好，一直換邊才會搓得均勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even? Mine keeps wobbling.
dialogue.zh: 均勻？我這顆一直在晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the high side twice, then feel.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə haɪ saɪd twaɪs ðɛn fil/
dialogue.zh: 把凸起那邊壓兩次，再用手感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feel for smoothness, not for marks.
dialogue.zh: 要摸的是平滑，不是痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marks show where your fingers rested.
dialogue.zh: 痕跡會指出你手指停在哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How hard should I press?
dialogue.zh: 我該用多大的力氣壓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hard enough to flatten, soft enough to turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑrd ɪˈnʌf tu ˈflætən sɔft ɪˈnʌf tu tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 壓得扁，但還轉得動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Size matters, grapefruit, not orange.
dialogue.zh: 大小有講究，要葡萄柚，不要橘子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What if the ball is too big?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə bɔl ɪz tu bɪɡ/
dialogue.zh: 如果泥球太大會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big balls need more wedging first.
dialogue.zh: 大球更要先多揉幾下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve folds, then roll again.
dialogue.zh: 折十二下，再重新搓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve! My arms ache already.
dialogue.zh: 十二下！我手臂已經在痠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest one minute, clay keeps its shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst wʌn ˈmɪnɪt kleɪ kips ɪts ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 休息一分鐘，泥巴不會跑掉形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it dry out while I rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt draɪ aʊt waɪl aɪ rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 我休息時它會變乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover it with a damp cloth.
dialogue.zh: 用濕布蓋著就不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Damp cloth, not dripping wet one.
dialogue.zh: 是微濕的布，不是滴水的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, a wet cloth leaves skin.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，太濕的布會讓表面起皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skin? Like a shiny film?
dialogue.zh: 起皮？像發亮的一層膜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that film hides new cracks.
dialogue.zh: 對，那層膜會蓋住新裂紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cracks appear at the edge, right?
dialogue.zh: 裂紋都先從邊緣出現，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Edge cracks mean the clay is dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛdʒ kræks min ðə kleɪ ɪz draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 邊角裂就代表泥巴太乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I knead in some water?
dialogue.zh: 那我該揉一點水進去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A teaspoon, no more, then wedge.
dialogue.zh: 一茶匙就好，然後再揉勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wedge now, on the sloped board?
dialogue.zh: 現在要揉到斜板上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat board today; the slope comes later.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt bɔrd təˈdeɪ ðə sloʊp kʌmz ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 今天用平板，斜板之後再學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later? Our lesson has an end.
dialogue.zh: 之後？我們這堂課也會下課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours, then clean up together.
dialogue.zh: 兩個小時，然後一起整理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Together? I like the quiet cleanup.
dialogue.zh: 一起？我喜歡安安靜靜地收拾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet, but the broom makes noise.
dialogue.zh: 安靜是安靜，但掃把會吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broom? Clay dust is everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 掃把？泥巴粉各處都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweep it into the floor drain.
dialogue.zh: 掃進地上的排水口就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down the drain? That feels wrong.
dialogue.zh: 掃進排水口？感覺不太好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust, yes; scraps go in the bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst jɛs skræps ɡoʊ ɪn ðə bɪn/
dialogue.zh: 粉塵可以，碎泥塊要進桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bin for scraps, box for good clay.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪn fɔr skræps bɑks fɔr ɡʊd kleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 桶丟碎泥，箱子裝好泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, never mix dry with wet.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，乾濕絕對不要混。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snake next, I think?
dialogue.zh: 接下來搓長條？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll it long, like your forearm.
dialogue.zh: 搓到有前臂那麼長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My forearm is quite short.
dialogue.zh: 我的前臂滿短的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then make three short snakes.
dialogue.zh: 那就搓三條短的泥條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even thickness along the whole snake.
dialogue.zh: 整條都要粗細一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fingerprints help you keep it thin.
dialogue.zh: 指腹的紋路會幫你搓細。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin ends split when I bend it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn ɛndz splɪt wɛn aɪ bɛnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩頭太細，一彎就斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the ends thicker, then join.
dialogue.zh: 兩頭留粗一點，再接起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Join end to end, then press.
dialogue.zh: 頭尾相接，再壓實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blend the seam with a wet finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /blɛnd ðə sim wɪð ə wɛt ˈfɪŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 用濕手指把接縫抹平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seam still shows a bump.
dialogue.zh: 接縫還是鼓起一個包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub it in circles, five times.
dialogue.zh: 畫圈抹它五次看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coil now? Mine looks like rope.
dialogue.zh: 現在盤條？我的看起來像繩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rope is fine; coils make strong pots.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊp ɪz faɪn kɔɪlz meɪk strɔŋ pɑts/
dialogue.zh: 像繩子沒關係，盤條的坯最結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the first pot will be a coil pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə fɜrst pɑt wɪl bi ə kɔɪl pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 所以第一個作品是盤條壺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stack three coils on a base.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs stæk θri kɔɪlz ɑn ə beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，在底座上疊三圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack them wet, or let each dry?
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk ðɛm wɛt ɔr lɛt itʃ draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 要趁濕的時候疊，還是等它乾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leather hard, damp but not soft.
dialogue.zh: 疊到皮革硬度，濕但不軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Damp but firm, got the feel?
dialogue.zh: 濕但堅實，那種手感抓到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press and it dents; that is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ænd ɪt dɛnts ðæt ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一按會凹，就是那個感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coil dented, is that bad?
dialogue.zh: 我的泥條被按凹了，很糟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the wall gets too thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə wɔl ɡɛts tu θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 只有壁被壓得太薄時才糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too thin walls fall in the kiln.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu θɪn wɔlz fɔl ɪn ðə kɪln/
dialogue.zh: 壁太薄，進窯就會倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And too thick walls burst with steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd tu θɪk wɔlz bɜrst wɪð stim/
dialogue.zh: 壁太厚，蒸汽會把它撐爆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steam inside thick clay, scary.
dialogue.zh: 厚泥裡的蒸汽，想想就可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very. Keep every wall equal.
dialogue.zh: 真的很可怕，所以每面壁都要同厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Equal walls take practice, clearly.
dialogue.zh: 壁厚一致顯然要靠練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make five balls today; forget perfect.
dialogue.zh: 今天先搓五顆球，別管完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five balls, then five fat snakes?
dialogue.zh: 五顆球，再搓五條粗條？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, size builds your hand memory.
dialogue.zh: 對，一樣大小才能練出手感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand memory, nice phrase, teacher.
dialogue.zh: 手感記憶，這說法真好，老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it while you roll, it helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt waɪl ju roʊl ɪt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 邊搓邊唸，會更有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slabs too? We cut those today?
dialogue.zh: 泥板也要？今天就要切？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll flat, then cut with the wire.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl flæt ðɛn kʌt wɪð ðə ˈwaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 先輥平，再用割線切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wire cuts clay like cold butter.
dialogue.zh: 割線切泥像切冷奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One clean pull, no back and forth.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klin pʊl noʊ bæk ænd fɔrθ/
dialogue.zh: 一次拉到底，不要來回鋸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thickness card? What is that thing?
dialogue.zh: 厚度卡？那是什麼東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stiff card that sets the height.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɪf kɑrd ðæt sɛts ðə haɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一張硬卡，用來決定厚度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slide it under the rolling pin.
dialogue.zh: 把它墊在土輥下面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cards, one each side, keep even.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kɑrdz wʌn itʃ saɪd kip ˈivən/
dialogue.zh: 兩張，一邊一張，就會平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rolling pin stuck to the clay.
dialogue.zh: 土輥黏在泥上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust the pin, not the whole slab.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ðə pɪn nɑt ðə hoʊl slæb/
dialogue.zh: 只在輥上撲粉，別撒整版。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry clay powder is everywhere now.
dialogue.zh: 乾泥粉現在撒得到處都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sprinkle a little on your board.
dialogue.zh: 你的板上灑一點就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Board, hands, clothes, all white now.
dialogue.zh: 板子、手、衣服，全都白了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clay dust loves a dark shirt.
dialogue.zh: 泥粉最愛深色衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Note for next time: wear gray.
dialogue.zh: 記一下，下次穿灰色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear gray and lose it anyway.
dialogue.zh: 穿灰的，最後也還是會報廢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lose it? You mean the shirt?
dialogue.zh: 報廢？你是說那件襯衫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and your hands keep the dirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd jʊr hændz kip ði dɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 對，是你的雙手留著泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dirt under nails, classic finish.
dialogue.zh: 指甲裡全是泥，經典收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrub twice, the sink is warm now.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrʌb twaɪs ðə sɪŋk ɪz wɔrm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 刷兩遍，水槽現在是溫水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm water, nice, thanks for that.
dialogue.zh: 溫水，真好，謝謝你告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time, balls on the tray?
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，球要放托盤上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tray is full, where do they dry?
dialogue.phonetic: /treɪ ɪz fʊl wɛr du ðeɪ draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 托盤滿了，放哪裡風乾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shelf three, loose, not touching.
dialogue.zh: 第三層架，留空隙，別碰著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not touching? They stick while wet.
dialogue.zh: 不能碰？濕的時候會黏住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then space them, one hand apart.
dialogue.zh: 那就拉開一個手掌的距離。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wheel eight is yours tonight.
dialogue.zh: 八號拉坯機今晚是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit low, knees inside the wheel.
dialogue.zh: 坐低一點，膝蓋收進機內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feet flat on the metal plate.
dialogue.zh: 腳平踩在金屬踏板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that plate holds the pedal.
dialogue.zh: 對，那塊板下面就是踏板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pedal makes the head spin?
dialogue.zh: 踩踏板就會讓轉盤轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press gently; fast is not better.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕踩，快不等於好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast wheels throw me off.
dialogue.zh: 轉太快我會手忙腳亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start slow, the clay needs trust.
dialogue.zh: 先慢，泥巴需要被信任。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trust? The wheel hums so loud.
dialogue.zh: 信任？這機子嗡得好大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud means the motor works hard.
dialogue.zh: 大聲代表馬達在使力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Motor under my seat, then.
dialogue.zh: 馬達就在我座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the splash pan, keep hands clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə splæʃ pæn kip hændz klɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在擋泥盤底下，手別伸進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Splash pan catches all the mud.
dialogue.zh: 擋泥盤會接住所有泥漿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly mud, partly your shirt.
dialogue.zh: 大部分是泥，一小部分是襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Apron front is soaked already.
dialogue.zh: 圍裙前面已經整片濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change it, the hook has spares.
dialogue.zh: 去換一件，鉤子上有備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spares feel stiff and cold.
dialogue.zh: 備用的摸起來又硬又冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry clay smell, nothing more.
dialogue.zh: 就是乾泥味，沒別的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cup of water on the rim?
dialogue.zh: 水杯放在邊緣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the pan edge, away from clay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə pæn ɛdʒ əˈweɪ frʌm kleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 放盤緣，離泥巴遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Away from clay? It tips easily.
dialogue.zh: 離泥遠？它很容易倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest it in the pan notch.
dialogue.zh: 卡在盤子那個凹口就不會倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notch holds it, nice and dry.
dialogue.zh: 凹口卡住了，穩又乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until the first splash ruins that.
dialogue.zh: 等第一潑泥水濺上來就泡湯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ball on the wheel head now?
dialogue.zh: 現在把泥球放到轉盤上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slap it down hard, center it.
dialogue.zh: 用力拍下去，然後抓中心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slap? Like a pizza dough?
dialogue.zh: 拍？像丟披薩麵團那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly that, but wetter and colder.
dialogue.zh: 就是那樣，但更濕也更冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet hands, then start the wheel.
dialogue.zh: 先把手弄濕，再開機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow speed first, keep your elbows locked.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ spiːd fɜrst kip jʊr ˈɛlboʊz lɑkt/
dialogue.zh: 先慢速，手肘固定住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elbows locked against my hips.
dialogue.zh: 手肘抵在胯兩側。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hips, ribs, use your body, not fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪps rɪbz juːz jʊr ˈbɑdi nɑt ˈfɪŋɡərz/
dialogue.zh: 靠胯和肋骨，不要只用指頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Body weight pushes the clay up.
dialogue.zh: 體重會讓泥巴往上長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the wheel is fast enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə wiːl ɪz fæst ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 前提是轉速要夠快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Faster now? My head spins.
dialogue.zh: 再快一點？我頭都在暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, the ball is wobbling badly.
dialogue.zh: 等等，泥球晃得很厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wobbling means it is off center.
dialogue.zh: 會晃就是中心沒抓正。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop, wet your palms, squeeze again.
dialogue.zh: 停，打濕手掌，再擠一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Squeeze inward and upward, both.
dialogue.zh: 一邊往內一邊往上擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one motion, do not think.
dialogue.zh: 對，一個動作，別思考。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not thinking is hard at lesson three.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ɪz hɑrd æt ˈlɛsən θri/
dialogue.zh: 到第三課還叫我不想，太難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lesson three? This is your first wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛsən θri ðɪs ɪz jʊr fɜrst wiːl/
dialogue.zh: 第三課？這是你的第一次拉坯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First wheel, so be kind to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst wiːl soʊ bi kaɪnd tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 第一次拉坯，請多包涵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind and honest: it is still off.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd ænd ˈɑnɪst ɪt ɪz stɪl ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 客氣但誠實，它還是偏著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still off? I feel a bump.
dialogue.zh: 還是偏？我摸到一個鼓包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bump high, press the top, gently.
dialogue.zh: 包在上面，輕輕壓頂部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Top, side, bottom, one smooth dome.
dialogue.zh: 頂、側、底，揉成一個平滑的穹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now the dome is centered.
dialogue.zh: 完美，現在中心穩住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Centered! My hands did that.
dialogue.zh: 抓正了！是我雙手做到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hands and a very patient wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr hændz ænd ə ˈvɛri ˈpeɪʃənt wiːl/
dialogue.zh: 你的手，加上一台很有耐心的機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it now with my thumb?
dialogue.zh: 現在用拇指開中心？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thumb down slow, keep the wheel fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /θʌm daʊn sloʊ kip ðə wiːl fæst/
dialogue.zh: 拇指慢慢下壓，機速要維持快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hole appears, water everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 洞出現了，水四處飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the floor, not your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə flɔr nɑt jʊr feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那是地板，幸好不是你的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the pan, then pull the walls.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə pæn ðɛn pʊl ðə wɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 擦乾淨擋泥盤，再拉高壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside hand pushes, outside hand supports.
dialogue.zh: 裡面的手推，外面的手撐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside fingers push, outside fingers wait?
dialogue.zh: 裡面推，外面等著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push and rise together, very slowly.
dialogue.zh: 兩手一起推著往上，非常慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine rose into a tall cylinder.
dialogue.zh: 我的拉成一根高圓筒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cylinders fall if they grow too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪləndərz fɔl ɪf ðeɪ ɡroʊ tu fæst/
dialogue.zh: 圓筒長太快一定會倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So stop rising at six inches.
dialogue.zh: 所以拉到六吋就停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is plenty; measure with your fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ˈplɛnti ˈmɛʒər wɪð jʊr ˈfɪŋɡərz/
dialogue.zh: 六吋夠了，用手指量就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four fingers, thumb, that is the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈfɪŋɡərz θʌm ðæt ɪz ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 四指加拇指，就是牆的厚度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now rib it on the outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ rɪb ɪt ɑn ðə ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 很好，現在用刮片修外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rib leaves a shiny stripe.
dialogue.zh: 刮片會留下一道亮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stripes fade under glaze, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /straɪps feɪd ˈʌndər ɡleɪz du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 上釉後痕跡會不見，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glaze later, but the wheel is tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡleɪz ˈleɪtər bʌt ðə wiːl ɪz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 釉是之後的事，今晚只有拉坯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. Cut it off the head now.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt kʌt ɪt ɔf ðə hɛd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對，現在把它從轉盤割下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut with the wire, pull toward me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt wɪð ðə ˈwaɪər pʊl təˈwɔrd mi/
dialogue.zh: 用割線，朝我這邊拉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toward you, flat, one clean pass.
dialogue.zh: 朝你，拉平，一次到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pass, then lift with both palms.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pæs ðɛn lɪft wɪð boʊθ pɑmz/
dialogue.zh: 一次割好，再用兩片手掌托起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift it onto the wooden board.
dialogue.zh: 托到木板上放好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Board first, then my name on tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔrd fɜrst ðɛn maɪ neɪm ɑn teɪp/
dialogue.zh: 先上牌，再用膠帶寫名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape is by the sink, one roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ɪz baɪ ðə sɪŋk wʌn roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 膠帶在水槽邊，還有一整捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name plus date, or just the name?
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm plʌs deɪt ɔr dʒʌst ðə neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 名字加日期，還是只寫名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, or the shelf gets confusing.
dialogue.zh: 都寫，不然架子會大混亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Confusing in week two, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 第二週一定會亂，無庸置疑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twenty cups, all gray, all wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtwɛnti kʌps ɔl ɡreɪ ɔl wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 對，二十個杯子，全灰全濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cups? We are making cups tonight?
dialogue.zh: 杯子？我們今晚做的是杯子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cylinders now; handles make them mugs.
dialogue.zh: 現在先拉圓筒，加了把手才算馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mugs can wait, then. Fine by me.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌɡz kæn weɪt ðɛn faɪn baɪ mi/
dialogue.zh: 那馬克杯可以等，我沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but the class ends at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn bʌt ðə klæs ɛndz æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，但八點要下課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight means I rush this second one.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt minz aɪ rʌʃ ðɪs ˈsɛkənd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 八點代表第二個我得趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not rush a wheel; it punishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt rʌʃ ə wiːl ɪt ˈpʌnɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 別催拉坯機，它會懲罰你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Punishes how? It just wobbles?
dialogue.zh: 怎麼懲罰？只是晃一晃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast hands make thin spots, then holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst hændz meɪk θɪn spɑts ðɛn hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 手太快壁會變薄，然後破洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Holes mean a lost evening.
dialogue.zh: 破洞就代表今晚白做了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or a lesson about steady breath.
dialogue.zh: 或者是穩定呼吸的一課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady breath, I forget that part.
dialogue.zh: 穩定呼吸，那點我常忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out when you pull upward.
dialogue.zh: 往上拉的時候要吐氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wheel is stopping; add some speed.
dialogue.zh: 機子在慢下來，加點速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pedal down, listen for the hum.
dialogue.zh: 踩下去，聽那個嗡嗡聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hum steady, good, now water the clay.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ˈstɛdi ɡʊd naʊ ˈwɔtər ðə kleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗡聲穩了，好，現在加水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cupped hand, little water, never pour.
dialogue.zh: 手掌兜著，水要少，不能倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never pour? My shoulder is tired.
dialogue.zh: 不能倒水？我肩膀好累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoulders down; rest them on your thighs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊldərz daʊn rɛst ðɛm ɑn jʊr θaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 肩膀沉下來，靠在大腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thighs, elbows, hips, all braced.
dialogue.zh: 大腿、手肘、胯，全部撐住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! The body holds, the hands only guide.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈbɑdi hoʊldz ðə hændz ˈoʊnli ɡaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對！身體負責撐，手只負責導。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guide, not push. Got it, finally.
dialogue.zh: 是引導，不是硬推，終於懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally! Your first cylinder is standing.
dialogue.zh: 是啊！你第一個圓筒正站著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It leaned and the wall folded.
dialogue.zh: 它歪了一下，壁就摺起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folded? Show me the bottom, please.
dialogue.zh: 摺了？請把底部給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the base stayed thick.
dialogue.zh: 你看，底部還是保持很厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thick base, thin top, it had to fall.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk beɪs θɪn tɑp ɪt hæd tu fɔl/
dialogue.zh: 底厚頂薄，它非倒不可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I made it uneven?
dialogue.zh: 所以是我把它弄得厚薄不均？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Uneven walls always lose the fight.
dialogue.zh: 壁厚不均，一定撐不過拉力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fight? It is only soft mud.
dialogue.zh: 撐不過？它只是軟軟的泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mud keeps every mistake you make.
dialogue.zh: 泥會忠實留下你的每個錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap therapy, then, this wheel.
dialogue.zh: 那這台拉坯機算很便宜的治療。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Therapy costs more; this class costs less.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɛrəpi kɔsts mɔr ðɪs klæs kɔsts lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 治療比較貴，這門課比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less? I paid for two hours.
dialogue.zh: 便宜？我可是付了兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours of wedging is fair.
dialogue.zh: 兩小時光揉泥就值得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Can I remake this one?
dialogue.zh: 值得。這一件可以重做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ball it up and center again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bɔl ɪt ʌp ænd ˈsɛntər əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，重新搓圓再抓一次中心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ball it up, just squeeze?
dialogue.zh: 搓圓，就是用手擠回去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeeze out the air while you roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwiːz aʊt ði ɛr waɪl ju roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 邊滾要把空氣一起擠出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Air again? I thought I wedged.
dialogue.zh: 又有空氣？我以為揉夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wedged, but not enough for this size.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛdʒt bʌt nɑt ɪˈnʌf fɔr ðɪs saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 是有揉，但這個量還不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This size needs twenty wedges.
dialogue.zh: 這個大小要揉二十下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them; keeping score helps focus.
dialogue.zh: 邊數邊揉，比較能專心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Focus is hard with cold fingers.
dialogue.zh: 手指冰冰冷的很難專心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm them under the tap first.
dialogue.zh: 先去水龍頭下暖一下手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water again, of course.
dialogue.zh: 又是冷水，當然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kettle is empty, sorry about that.
dialogue.zh: 溫水壺空了，真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry? You are the teacher here.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思？你才是這裡的老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teacher, and out of warm water.
dialogue.zh: 是老師，但溫水真的用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry hands, then, wheel speed low.
dialogue.zh: 擦乾手，再把機速轉低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low speed, high patience; try that.
dialogue.zh: 低速、高耐心，先這樣試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try again feels boring, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，重做一次很無聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boring is the wheel teaching you.
dialogue.zh: 無聊的正是機器在教你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Teaching what? It collapsed twice.
dialogue.zh: 教我什麼？它已經塌了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice means your elbow drifts outward.
dialogue.zh: 兩次代表你的手肘一直往外跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drifts outward, I see it now.
dialogue.zh: 往外跑，我現在看清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brace that elbow on your thigh.
dialogue.zh: 把那一側手肘抵住大腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thigh or hip? It slips either way.
dialogue.phonetic: /θaɪ ɔr hɪp ɪt slɪps ˈiːðər weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 抵大腿還是抵胯？都會滑開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tuck a towel under your arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʌk ə ˈtaʊəl ˈʌndər jʊr ɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 那就在腋下墊一條毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Towel prop, clever and sad.
dialogue.zh: 用毛巾當支柱，聰明但悲哀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sad potters make the best cups.
dialogue.zh: 肯承認難看的陶匠，杯子最好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best cups? Mine looks lopsided.
dialogue.zh: 最好用？我這件根本是歪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lopsided fires crooked, that is honest.
dialogue.zh: 歪著進窯就歪著出窯，很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honest crooked, I will take that.
dialogue.zh: 誠實地歪，這個我接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it, but fix the rim first.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt bʌt fɪks ðə rɪm fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 接受沒問題，但先把杯口修好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rim is wavy, like a fan.
dialogue.zh: 杯口波浪起伏，像扇子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waves show every hand shake.
dialogue.zh: 波浪會記錄下每一次手抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake is worse when I hold tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ɪz wɜrs wɛn aɪ hoʊld taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 握得越緊，抖得越凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hold loosely; grip is not work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hoʊld ˈlusli ɡrɪp ɪz nɑt wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 那就放鬆扶著，抓得緊不等於做活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grip is not work? Say that again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrɪp ɪz nɑt wɜrk seɪ ðæt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 抓緊不等於做活？再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fingers steer; the wheel does the pulling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪŋɡərz stɪr ðə wiːl dʌz ðə ˈpʊlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 手指只管方向，拉伸交給機台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steering, then. Slower, please?
dialogue.zh: 那我管方向。可以再慢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slower speed, and breathe out fully.
dialogue.zh: 再慢一點，而且把氣吐乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathing helps more than thinking.
dialogue.zh: 呼吸比思考更有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thinking is for glaze day.
dialogue.zh: 對，思考是留給上釉那天的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glaze day sounds much easier.
dialogue.zh: 上釉那天聽起來輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easier hands, harder choices, wait.
dialogue.zh: 手變輕鬆，選擇變更難，你等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, this one is standing still!
dialogue.zh: 等等，這一個居然站住了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standing, wobbling slightly, but standing.
dialogue.zh: 站著，微微晃，但站住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slightly wobbling is fine, right?
dialogue.zh: 微微晃應該還在範圍內吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine; pots are never perfectly round.
dialogue.zh: 沒事，壺從來不會百分之百圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never perfectly round, noted.
dialogue.zh: 從來不完全圓，這句話我記下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on the studio wall.
dialogue.zh: 把它寫在工作室牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wall? That is a nice poster.
dialogue.zh: 牆上？那是一張很美的海報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Handwritten, by the last beginner.
dialogue.zh: 上個新手親手寫上去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beginner! Did she finish the course?
dialogue.zh: 新手！她把整個課程上完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She kept five of twelve pots.
dialogue.zh: 十二件裡她最後留下五件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five of twelve, so seven failed.
dialogue.zh: 十二留五，那七件是失敗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Failed, or given away, or loved.
dialogue.zh: 失敗、送人，或是被誰愛走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loved crooked cups? People really do.
dialogue.zh: 有人會愛歪歪的杯子？真的會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Especially the ones with hand marks.
dialogue.zh: 特別是那種留著手印的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand marks show in the final cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd mɑrks ʃoʊ ɪn ðə ˈfaɪnəl kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 手印在成品杯上也看得到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, glaze covers nothing completely.
dialogue.zh: 看得到，釉蓋不掉任何痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I want deep finger marks.
dialogue.zh: 那我要深深的指痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press now, while the wall is wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs naʊ waɪl ðə wɔl ɪz wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 趁壁還濕，現在就按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressing leaves a thumb print ring.
dialogue.zh: 一按就留下一圈拇指印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ring it once, twice is clutter.
dialogue.zh: 繞一圈就好，兩圈就顯亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clutter, right. Keep it simple.
dialogue.zh: 會顯亂，對。保持簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple pots get used every morning.
dialogue.zh: 簡單的作品才會每天早上被用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning use means a good handle.
dialogue.zh: 天天用，代表把手得好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Handles come next term, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhændəlz kʌm nɛkst tɜrm du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 把手要下一期才教，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next term feels very far away.
dialogue.zh: 下一期感覺好遙遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far, but the kiln moves fast.
dialogue.zh: 遠是遠，但窯的進度很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast kiln, slow hands, my rule.
dialogue.zh: 窯要快、手要慢，我的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good rule; repeat it while you pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd rul rɪˈpit ɪt waɪl ju pʊl/
dialogue.zh: 好規矩，拉的時候在嘴邊唸著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wall is thinning on one side.
dialogue.zh: 其中一面壁越來越薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thicken it, add a clay rope.
dialogue.zh: 要補厚，加一條細泥條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rope stuck outside looks odd.
dialogue.zh: 在外面黏一條，看起來好怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blend it inward, smooth with your rib.
dialogue.phonetic: /blɛnd ɪt ɪnˈwərd smuð wɪð jʊr rɪb/
dialogue.zh: 往內抹開，再用刮片修平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blending is my least favorite part.
dialogue.zh: 抹平是我最討厭的一個步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Least favorite parts make pots last.
dialogue.zh: 最不討喜的那步，才讓壺用得久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pots that last or pots that sell?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑts ðæt læst ɔr pɑts ðæt sɛl/
dialogue.zh: 是用得久的，還是賣得掉的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both need the same smooth seam.
dialogue.zh: 兩者都需要同一道平滑接縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smooth seam, check. Any crack left?
dialogue.zh: 接縫平滑，合格。還剩裂縫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hair crack, near the base joint.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɛr kræk nɪr ðə beɪs dʒɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 一道髮絲裂，在底座接痕旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Joint cracks open in the kiln.
dialogue.zh: 接痕進了窯會整個裂開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Score it, slip it, press it shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɔr ɪt slɪp ɪt prɛs ɪt ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 先刮粗、上泥漿，再壓合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slip is liquid clay, right?
dialogue.zh: 泥漿就是化成水的泥，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clay and water, thick as cream.
dialogue.zh: 泥加水，調到鮮奶油的濃度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cream thick, then brush it in.
dialogue.zh: 像奶油一樣稠，再刷進縫裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brush, or your finger, both work.
dialogue.zh: 刷子或手指都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. It is ugly and mine.
dialogue.zh: 完成了，它很醜，可是是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugly and yours is the goal.
dialogue.zh: 又醜又是你的，就是今晚的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today no wheel, just our hands.
dialogue.zh: 今天不上拉坯機，只用雙手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pinch pots, small cups, no tools.
dialogue.zh: 用手捏小壺、小杯子，不用工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tools feels suspicious somehow.
dialogue.zh: 不用工具，總覺得有詐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thumbs are the only tool today.
dialogue.zh: 拇指就是今天唯一的工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thumb into the ball, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 拇指按進泥球，慢慢地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press a hole, then widen it.
dialogue.zh: 先壓出一個洞，再撐大它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Widening with my thumb tip.
dialogue.zh: 用拇指尖一點一點撐開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rotate the ball in your palm.
dialogue.zh: 手掌同時轉動那顆球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rotate and pinch, one turn each.
dialogue.zh: 一邊轉一邊捏，每轉一圈捏一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the cup grows by turns.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，杯子是一圈一圈長大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine grew sideways instead of up.
dialogue.zh: 我那顆是往長，不是往高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sideways means your thumb went downward.
dialogue.zh: 往長代表你的拇指一直往下壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Downward, yes. Now pinch the walls.
dialogue.zh: 往下，對了。現在捏壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pinch from the bottom going up.
dialogue.zh: 要從杯底一路捏到杯口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bottom first, always the bottom.
dialogue.zh: 先底部，永遠都是先底部。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thin base cannot hold coffee.
dialogue.zh: 底太薄，連咖啡都裝不住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee needs a thick floor.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡需要一個厚杯底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a centimeter, no less.
dialogue.zh: 半公分，少一點都不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half centimeter, I have no ruler.
dialogue.zh: 半公分？我又沒帶尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two stacked coins, feel the gap.
dialogue.zh: 兩枚硬幣疊起來，比較那個縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins? My pocket has only lint.
dialogue.zh: 硬幣？我口袋只有線頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the wall gauge on shelf two.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə wɔl ɡeɪdʒ ɑn ʃɛlf tu/
dialogue.zh: 用第二層架那個厚度卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gauge is that wooden strip?
dialogue.zh: 厚度卡就是那根木條？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, notches mark every wall width.
dialogue.zh: 對，上面的缺口代表各種壁厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Width check, then a smooth inside.
dialogue.zh: 厚度查過，再來把裡面抹平滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth inside with a wet sponge.
dialogue.zh: 裡面用濕海綿抹一圈就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sponge leaves tiny dimples here.
dialogue.zh: 海綿在這裡留下小凹點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dimples grip lips, people like them.
dialogue.zh: 小凹點好貼嘴唇，人們喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lips? Now I think about drinking.
dialogue.zh: 嘴唇？我現在開始想到喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every cup is for a mouth.
dialogue.zh: 每一隻杯子都是為了嘴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mouth, and a hot drink.
dialogue.zh: 一張嘴，還有一杯熱飲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no sharp rim on top.
dialogue.zh: 所以杯口不能割嘴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rim needs rounding with a finger.
dialogue.zh: 杯口要用手指揉圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet finger, one circle, no pressing.
dialogue.zh: 手指弄濕，繞一圈，不要壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressing flattens my good ring.
dialogue.zh: 一壓就毀了我漂亮的圓圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hold it higher, at eye level.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hoʊld ɪt ˈhaɪər æt aɪ ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 那就舉高一點，跟眼睛同高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eye level shows a hidden lean.
dialogue.zh: 平視才發現它偷偷歪了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean it back with two pinches.
dialogue.zh: 捏兩下把它扶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pinching out only shifts the curve.
dialogue.zh: 往外捏只是移動弧度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then blend, do not chase symmetry.
dialogue.zh: 那就抹勻，不要追對稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Symmetry is a wheel thing.
dialogue.zh: 對稱那是拉坯機的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wheel or hands, the cup still leans.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiːl ɔr hændz ðə kʌp stɪl linz/
dialogue.zh: 不管用哪種，杯子還是會歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leans is my favorite verb today.
dialogue.zh: 歪這個動詞是我今天最愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it twice more and we eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt twaɪs mɔr ænd wi it/
dialogue.zh: 再讓我們歪兩回，就要吃飯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eat? Is there food at seven?
dialogue.zh: 吃？七點有吃的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snacks by the sink, help yourself.
dialogue.zh: 點心在水槽邊，自己拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snacks, then tea, then more pinching.
dialogue.zh: 點心、茶，然後繼續捏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three cups, stack them lightly.
dialogue.zh: 對，三隻杯子，輕輕疊起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stacked cups stick while they dry.
dialogue.zh: 疊著的杯子乾了會黏在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Separate them with a paper strip.
dialogue.zh: 中間墊一張紙條就不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper strip, clever, like wax paper.
dialogue.zh: 墊紙條，聰明，像蠟紙那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wax paper, but never on a glaze face.
dialogue.phonetic: /wæks ˈpeɪpər bʌt ˈnɛvər ɑn ə ɡleɪz feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 蠟紙可以，但別壓到上釉面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glaze face? Meaning the outside?
dialogue.zh: 上釉面？指的是外面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The outside takes color, inside stays plain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd teɪks ˈkʌlər ɪnˈsaɪd steɪz pleɪn/
dialogue.zh: 外面吃顏色，裡面就素著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plain inside suits a tea cup.
dialogue.zh: 裡面素著剛好適合茶杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea shows every scratch, though.
dialogue.zh: 可是茶會顯出每一道刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scratches come from my nails.
dialogue.zh: 刮痕是我指甲弄出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: File them short, and come back tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪl ðɛm ʃɔrt ænd kʌm bæk təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚把指甲磨短，明天再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we start the handle lesson?
dialogue.zh: 明天要上把手課了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, tomorrow we carve your names.
dialogue.zh: 不，明天刻你們的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Carve names, into wet clay?
dialogue.zh: 刻名字，刻在濕泥上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into leather hard clay, a day from now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ˈlɛðər hɑːrd kleɪ ə deɪ frʌm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 刻在隔天那種皮革硬度的泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leather hard means it holds a cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛðər hɑːrd minz ɪt hoʊldz ə kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 皮革硬度代表刻得動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cut edges stay crisp, not floppy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kʌt ˈɛdʒɪz steɪ krɪsp nɑt ˈflɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 對，切口會清清楚楚，不會軟爛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crisp cuts need a sharp tool.
dialogue.zh: 清楚的切口需要尖利的工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use wooden ones, no sharp blades.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi juz ˈwʊdən wʌnz noʊ ʃɑrp bleɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 我們只用木的，不用刀片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wooden tools dull so quickly.
dialogue.zh: 木工具鈍得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rotate the stick, one quarter turn.
dialogue.zh: 把木筆轉四分之一圈接著用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quarter turn, like sharpening a pencil.
dialogue.zh: 轉個面，像削鉛筆那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pencils are exactly what we carve with.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəlz ɑr ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt wi kɑrv wɪð/
dialogue.zh: 我們刻字用的就是鉛筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pencil! I feel like a student.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpɛnsəl aɪ fil laɪk ə ˈstuːdənt/
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆！我感覺自己像學生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are, and clay is your homework.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ænd kleɪ ɪz jʊr ˈhoʊmˌwɜːrk/
dialogue.zh: 你就是，泥巴就是你的作業。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Homework feels honest for adults.
dialogue.zh: 大人有作業感覺比較誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Adults just call it practice time.
dialogue.zh: 大人只是把它改叫練習時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Practice time is nine minutes away.
dialogue.zh: 練習時間只剩九分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pinch one more tiny cup.
dialogue.zh: 那就再捏一隻小杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny cups make good tea lights.
dialogue.zh: 小杯子拿來放蠟燭剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea lights crack the smallest cups.
dialogue.zh: 蠟燭反而會讓最小的杯子裂開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no candles, just my tea?
dialogue.zh: 所以不點蠟燭，只裝我的茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only tea. Now tap the wall and listen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ti naʊ tæp ðə wɔl ænd ˈlɪsən/
dialogue.zh: 只裝茶。現在敲一下杯壁，聽聽看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A clear ring means good firing.
dialogue.zh: 聲音清脆代表燒得對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dull thud warns of hidden cracks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʌl θʌd wɔːrnz əv ˈhɪdən kræks/
dialogue.zh: 悶悶的一聲，就是暗裂在警告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hidden cracks, of course. Nothing simple.
dialogue.zh: 暗裂，當然。沒有事是簡單的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pottery is simple, but never easy.
dialogue.zh: 陶藝很簡單，但從來不容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple and easy, my wish list.
dialogue.zh: 又簡單又輕鬆，我的心願清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wish for dry hands next time.
dialogue.zh: 下次就許個願，願雙手是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry hands? Mine soak like sponges.
dialogue.zh: 乾的手？我的手像海綿在吸水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest ten, the clay can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rɛst tɛn ðə kleɪ kæn weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就休息十分鐘，泥等得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, but do I cover them?
dialogue.zh: 好，不過我要把杯子蓋起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose bag, slow drying, no cracks.
dialogue.zh: 套個鬆袋子，慢慢乾，就不會裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest break, then my three cups.
dialogue.zh: 休息一下，然後我的三隻杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Label them now, before the break.
dialogue.zh: 休息前先把標籤貼好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Label tape ran out an hour ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbəl teɪp ræn aʊt ən ˈaʊər əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 標籤帶一個小時前就用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Masking tape works, write small.
dialogue.zh: 遮蔽膠帶也可以，字寫小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small letters, or the kiln eats them.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈlɛtərz ɔːr ðə kɪln its ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 字要小？窯會把它吃掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tape stays out; your carving goes in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə teɪp steɪz aʊt jʊr ˈkɑrvɪŋ goʊz ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 膠帶留在外面，你刻的字才會進窯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my name will survive two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ neɪm wɪl sərˈvaɪv tu wiks/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我的名字能撐過兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks, then your cup comes back.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiks ðɛn jʊr kʌp kʌmz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 兩週後，你的杯子會回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comes back finished, glazed, ready.
dialogue.zh: 回來的時候是成品，上了釉，能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready for tea, and for your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi fɔr ti ænd fɔr jʊr hændz/
dialogue.zh: 能裝茶，也能給你握著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today we carve into leather clay.
dialogue.zh: 今天要在皮革硬度的泥上刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leather hard, so it does not slump.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛðər hɑːrd soʊ ɪt dʌz nɑt slʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 硬到刻得動，又不會塌下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tools on the tray: sticks and wire.
dialogue.phonetic: /tulz ɑn ðə treɪ stɪks ænd ˈwaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 托盤上是木筆和割線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick a pointed stick for letters.
dialogue.zh: 刻字要挑一支尖的木筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pointed stick, then my full name?
dialogue.zh: 尖的那支，那刻全名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Initials read cleaner on a cup.
dialogue.zh: 杯子上刻縮寫看起來更乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Initials, yes. Pencil guide first?
dialogue.zh: 縮寫，好。先用鉛筆打底？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light pencil, then carve along the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt ˈpɛnsəl ðɛn kɑrv əˈlɔŋ ðə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆淡淡地畫，再沿線刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Carve deep or carve shallow?
dialogue.zh: 要刻深還是刻淺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep enough for glaze to sit in.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip ɪˈnʌf fɔːr ɡleɪz tu sɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 深到讓釉停在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glaze in the cut gives dark letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡleɪz ɪn ðə kʌt ɡɪvz dɑrk ˈlɛtərz/
dialogue.zh: 釉沉在刻痕裡，字會變深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or leave it bare for a soft look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːr liːv ɪt bɛr fɔːr ə sɔft lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 或者不施釉，顏色比較柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bare letters feel like a secret.
dialogue.zh: 素刻的字有一種祕密感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Secrets fade; carved letters stay for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsikrɪts feɪd kɑːrvd ˈlɛtərz steɪ fɔːr jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 祕密會淡，刻出來的字卻留得好幾年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Years! Then my spelling had better be right.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɪrz ðɛn maɪ ˈspɛlɪŋ hæd ˈbɛtər bi raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好幾年！那我的拼法最好是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on paper before the clay.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn ˈpeɪpər bɪˈfɔːr ðə kleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 先在紙上寫一遍，再下泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper checked, no wrong letters.
dialogue.zh: 紙上檢查過，沒有錯字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, clay does not forgive spelling.
dialogue.zh: 很好，泥巴不會原諒錯字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forgive? It shows every mistake.
dialogue.zh: 原諒？它會放大每個錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mistakes are small, but you will find them.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪˈsteɪks ɑr smɔl bʌt ju wɪl faɪnd ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 錯很小，但你一定找得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start with the first letter, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 從第一個字母開始，慢慢刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One stroke, then lift the stick clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn stroʊk ðɛn lɪft ðə stɪk klin/
dialogue.zh: 一筆刻完就收筆，收乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift clean, or a ridge stays?
dialogue.zh: 收筆不乾淨會留一道梗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A ridge stays if you drag it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɪdʒ steɪz ɪf ju dræɡ ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 往回拖就會留下一道梗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No dragging, single direction. Understood.
dialogue.zh: 不回拖，單向刻，明白了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and keep the letters the same size.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ænd kip ðə ˈlɛtərz ðə seɪm saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好，而且字母大小要一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same size is harder than it looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm saɪz ɪz ˈhɑːrdər ðæn ɪt lʊks/
dialogue.zh: 一樣大這件事比看起來更難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use a fingernail width as a guide.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ə ˈfɪŋɡərˌneɪl wɪtθ æz ə ɡaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 拿指甲的寬度當基準。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fingernail guide, that actually helps.
dialogue.zh: 指甲當尺，居然真的有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Help yourself to the curved stamp, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛlp jʊrˈsɛlf tu ðə kɜːrvd stæmp tuː/
dialogue.zh: 那枚弧形的章你也可以拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stamp? A stamp for initials?
dialogue.zh: 章？蓋縮寫用的章？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it once, straight, no rocking.
dialogue.zh: 壓一次，要正，不能搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rocking blurs the letter edges.
dialogue.zh: 一搖，字的邊框就糊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, so brace your wrist on the rim.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ breɪs jʊr rɪst ɑn ðə rɪm/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，所以手腕要靠杯口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrist braced, stamp ready, here goes.
dialogue.zh: 手腕靠好，章備妥，要按了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press, count to three, then lift straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs kaʊnt tu θriː ðɛn lɪft streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 壓住，數到三，再垂直抬起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three seconds, and the mark is faint.
dialogue.phonetic: /θriː ˈsɛkəndz ænd ðə mɑːrk ɪz feɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 三秒到了，印出來的痕好淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faint means your clay is too soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪnt miːnz jʊr kleɪ ɪz tu sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 太淡代表你的泥還偏軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too soft, so it needs a day more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sɔft soʊ ɪt nidz ə deɪ mɔːr/
dialogue.zh: 偏軟，那要再晾一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or carve it deeper, right now, gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːr kɑrv ɪt ˈdiːpər raɪt naʊ ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 或者現在改用刻的，輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deeper strokes, then clay crumbs fall.
dialogue.zh: 刻深了，泥屑就會往下掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow them off, never wipe them in.
dialogue.phonetic: /bloʊ ðɛm ɔːf ˈnɛvər waɪp ðɛm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 吹掉就好，別把它抹回縫裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blow? A breath fogs my glasses.
dialogue.zh: 吹？我一口氣眼鏡就起霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the soft brush, it sweeps crumbs.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə sɔft brʌʃ ɪt swiːps krʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 用軟毛刷，掃得乾淨多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brush crumbs, then one last look.
dialogue.zh: 掃掉泥屑，最後再看一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look from above, not from the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk frʌm əˈbʌv nɑt frʌm ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 要從正上方看，不是從旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Above shows a leaning M badly.
dialogue.zh: 從上面看，那個字母歪得很明顯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straighten it with one firm scratch.
dialogue.zh: 用一道果斷的刮痕拉正它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scratching makes white powder lines.
dialogue.zh: 刮過的線條會泛白粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Powder is good; it marks depth.
dialogue.zh: 有粉是好事，代表刻夠深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Depth marks, nice. What about my logo?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛpθ mɑːrks naɪs wʌt əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈloʊɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有深度，很好。那我的圖案呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A logo is fine, keep it small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈloʊɡoʊ ɪz faɪn kip ɪt smɔːl/
dialogue.zh: 圖案可以，不過要小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small leaf, maybe, on the base edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔːl lif ˈmeɪbi ɑn ðə beɪs ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 也許一片小葉子，放在底緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Base edge hides it, try the shoulder.
dialogue.phonetic: /beɪs ɛdʒ haɪdz ɪt traɪ ðə ˈʃoʊldər/
dialogue.zh: 底緣會藏住它，刻在杯肩吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoulder, yes, right under the rim.
dialogue.zh: 杯肩，對，就在杯口下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the rim shows it when pouring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə rɪm ʃoʊz ɪt wɛn ˈpɔːrɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那個位置倒水的時候最顯眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pouring? It is a cup, not a pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɔːrɪŋ ɪt ɪz ə kʌp nɑt ə pɑːt/
dialogue.zh: 倒水？這只是杯子，不是壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cups pour, so design for the pour.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌps pɔːr soʊ dɪˈzaɪn fɔːr ðə pɔːr/
dialogue.zh: 杯子也要倒，所以要替倒水設計。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the pour, and for the lips.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔːr ðə pɔːr ænd fɔːr ðə lɪps/
dialogue.zh: 替倒水設計，也替嘴唇設計。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lips touch the rim, keep carving shallow there.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪps tʌtʃ ðə rɪm kip ˈkɑrvɪŋ ˈʃæloʊ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 嘴唇會碰到杯口，那裡要刻淺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shallow there, deep on the body.
dialogue.zh: 杯口淺，杯身深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Body carries the name, rim stays clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑːdi ˈkæriz ðə neɪm rɪm steɪz klin/
dialogue.zh: 名字交給杯身，杯口保持乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name plus a year, tiny numbers.
dialogue.zh: 名字加年份，數字要刻小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Numbers in clay need round curves.
dialogue.zh: 泥裡的數字要有圓的弧度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round curves means zero must be a circle.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd kɜːrvz miːnz ˈzɪroʊ mʌst bi ə ˈsɜːrkəl/
dialogue.zh: 圓弧就代表零要刻成正圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or skip the year, keep two letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːr skɪp ðə jɪr kip tu ˈlɛtərz/
dialogue.zh: 不然年份別刻，只留兩個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two letters, one leaf, done here.
dialogue.zh: 兩個字母，一片葉，這樣收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sign the base with three dots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn saɪn ðə beɪs wɪð θriː dɑːts/
dialogue.zh: 然後在杯底點三個小記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three dots? A maker mark, like pros.
dialogue.phonetic: /θriː dɑːts ə ˈmeɪkər mɑːrk laɪk proʊz/
dialogue.zh: 三個點？像老師傅那樣的落款？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pros started with three dots, remember.
dialogue.zh: 老師傅也是從三個點開始的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember? Mine reads backward already.
dialogue.zh: 記得？我刻的字已經是反的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Backward? Show me. Yes, mirror it next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbækˌwərd ʃoʊ mi jɛs ˈmɪrər ɪt nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 反的？給我看。下次先在紙上鏡像排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mirror it on paper, then carve.
dialogue.zh: 先在紙上寫反的，再動刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good habit; clay cannot be undone.
dialogue.zh: 好習慣，泥上沒有返工這回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Undone, yes. Can I fix this stroke?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌnˈdʌn jɛs kæn aɪ fɪks ðɪs stroʊk/
dialogue.zh: 沒有返工。這一筆還能修嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth it with a damp fingertip.
dialogue.zh: 用濕的指腹抹一抹就平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fingertip smoothing leaves a shallow dip.
dialogue.zh: 指腹抹過會留下一個小窪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dips catch glaze, so it reads dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪps kætʃ ɡleɪz soʊ ɪt riːdz dɑːrk/
dialogue.zh: 窪會積釉，所以顏色看起來深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reads dark, so dips are lucky here.
dialogue.phonetic: /riːdz dɑːrk soʊ dɪps ɑːr ˈlʌki hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 看起來深，那這些窪是運氣好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky, or just planned badly. Either way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ɔːr dʒʌst plænd ˈbædli ˈiːðər weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是運氣還是沒規畫好，都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Planned badly is my whole style.
dialogue.zh: 沒規畫好大概就是全部風格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Style is just mistakes you keep.
dialogue.zh: 風格就是那些被你留下的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep them? Or trim the foot today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm ɔr trɪm ðə fʊt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就留著它們？還是今天先修杯底？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trim at leather hard, sand after firing.
dialogue.phonetic: /trɪm ət ˈlɛðər hɑrd sænd ˈæftər ˈfaɪərɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 皮革硬度時先修坯，燒過之後再磨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After firing, sanding is just dust.
dialogue.zh: 燒過再磨，磨出來的只有粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust, and a very clean apron again.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ænd ə ˈvɛri klin ˈeɪprən əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 是粉，也順便把圍裙再弄髒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean apron? Mine is a map now.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ˈeɪprən maɪn ɪz ə mæp naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 弄髒？我這件現在像地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maps show where the clay has been.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæps ʃoʊ wɛr ðə kleɪ hæz bɪn/
dialogue.zh: 地圖正好標示泥去過哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Been everywhere, including my hair.
dialogue.zh: 哪都有，包括我的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the mirror before the bus.
dialogue.zh: 搭巴士之前先去照鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bus at eight, so hurry up please.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌs æt eɪt soʊ ˈhɜːri ʌp pliz/
dialogue.zh: 八點有巴士，所以請快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finish the name, then wipe the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə neɪm ðɛn waɪp ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 先把名字刻完，再來擦桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Table wipe, tools back in the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪbəl waɪp tulz bæk ɪn ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 擦桌子，工具歸位到托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sticks upright, or they snap in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪks ˈʌpˌraɪt ɔːr ðeɪ snæp ɪn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 木筆要立著放，否則會斷成兩截。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snapped stick means a ruined letter.
dialogue.zh: 木筆一斷，那個字母就毀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ruined letters get a new cup base.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruˈɪnd ˈlɛtərz ɡɛt ə nju kʌp beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 毀了的字母，就換個新杯底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New base, same name. Fair trade.
dialogue.zh: 新的杯底，一樣的名字，划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, and your signature looks professional.
dialogue.zh: 划算，而且你的落款很專業。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Professional! Two weeks and I am a maker.
dialogue.phonetic: /prəˈfɛʃənəl tu wiːks ænd aɪ æm ə ˈmeɪkər/
dialogue.zh: 專業！兩週我就成了手作人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A maker with very dirty shoes.
dialogue.zh: 一個雙腳超髒的手作人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cup feels chalky and light.
dialogue.zh: 我的杯子摸起來乾乾的，又很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is bisque; it drinks the glaze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz bɪsk ɪt drɪŋks ðə ɡleɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那是素燒過的坯，會把釉吸進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is inside this white jar?
dialogue.zh: 這個白罐子裡裝的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk paint and ground glass only.
dialogue.zh: 只有奶釉和碎玻璃粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my cup look shiny or matte?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ kʌp lʊk ˈʃaɪni ɔr mæt/
dialogue.zh: 我的杯子該燒成亮面還是霧面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Matte shows every drop of grease.
dialogue.zh: 霧面會露出每一滴油漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ground glass makes the surface shiny?
dialogue.zh: 碎玻璃會讓表面變亮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It melts into a thin glass skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt mɛlts ˈɪntu ə θɪn ɡlæs skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 它融化成薄薄的一層玻璃皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those small squares on the shelf?
dialogue.zh: 架子上那些小方塊是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test tiles for every color choice.
dialogue.zh: 每種顏色都先燒一塊試片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do I dip a tile?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du aɪ dɪp ə taɪl/
dialogue.zh: 試片要浸幾秒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three seconds, then count out loud.
dialogue.zh: 三秒，然後大聲數出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting stops my hand from shaking.
dialogue.zh: 大聲數數，我的手就不抖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Early dips give a thin pale color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜrli dɪps ɡɪv ə θɪn peɪl ˈkʌlər/
dialogue.zh: 拿出來太早，顏色就淡淡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This spot is bare and rough.
dialogue.zh: 這一塊沒吃到釉，摸起來粗粗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bare clay stays rough after firing.
dialogue.zh: 沒上釉的泥巴燒完還是粗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I dip this cup twice?
dialogue.zh: 這個杯子可以浸兩次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice is normal, no shame here.
dialogue.zh: 浸兩次很正常，在這裡不用不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Between coats, does it need drying?
dialogue.zh: 兩層之間要等它乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry fully, or the glaze slides off.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ˈfʊli ɔr ðə ɡleɪz slaɪdz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 要全乾，不然釉會整片滑掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does this pot wait now?
dialogue.zh: 這個壺現在要放到哪裡等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down, onto the kiln shelf, forever.
dialogue.zh: 往下，放到窯板上，放到像永遠那麼久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why must I wipe the foot clean?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ mʌst aɪ waɪp ðə fʊt klin/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼杯底一定要擦乾淨？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glaze fuses pots to the shelf.
dialogue.zh: 釉會把壺和窯板燒在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This strip around the base is wax?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs strɪp əˈraʊnd ðə beɪs ɪz wæks/
dialogue.zh: 杯足這一圈是蠟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wax keeps the glaze off the ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /wæks kiːps ðə ɡleɪz ɔf ðə rɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 上蠟是為了讓釉不黏住足圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which blue, sky or deep ocean?
dialogue.zh: 要哪個藍，天藍還是深海藍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ocean is bold; sky is calm.
dialogue.zh: 深海藍大膽，天藍安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What makes this jar turn green, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt meɪks ðɪs dʒɑr tɜrn ɡrin ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那什麼東西讓這罐釉變成綠色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copper oxide, a little, gives blue green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpər ˈɑksaɪd ə ˈlɪtl ɡɪvz blu ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 一點點銅的氧化物會燒出藍綠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every jar has a number here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡每個罐子都有編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Match it with the firing chart.
dialogue.zh: 對照燒成表來記編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same number, different color tonight?
dialogue.zh: 同一個編號，今晚卻燒出不同色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thickness changes the fired color.
dialogue.zh: 釉的厚薄會改變燒出來的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is my cup darker at the bottom?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz maɪ kʌp ˈdɑrkər æt ðə ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 我的杯子底部為什麼比較深？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thicker pools gather at the foot.
dialogue.zh: 釉在杯足積得比較厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The top ran pale, is that wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɑp ræn peɪl ɪz ðæt rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 上面流得淡淡的，這樣不對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little drip is fine, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 有一點流釉沒關係，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How low can a drip reach?
dialogue.zh: 流下來的釉最多能到多低？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop it above the foot ring.
dialogue.zh: 讓它停在足圈上面就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brush feels slow compared to dipping.
dialogue.zh: 用筆刷感覺比整杯浸釉慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brush the letters, dip the rest.
dialogue.zh: 刻的字用筆刷，其餘整杯浸釉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tape, no lines, how divide?
dialogue.zh: 不用膠帶也沒有邊線，怎麼分隔？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wax draws the line for you.
dialogue.zh: 蠟會替你畫出那一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady hands still need a resting point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi hændz stɪl nid ə ˈrɛstɪŋ pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 再穩的手也要一個支點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your pinky on the rim edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jʊr ˈpɪŋki ɑn ðə rɪm ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 讓小指搭在杯緣當支點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These tricks took you years, right?
dialogue.zh: 這些竅門你學了好幾年吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tricks are just skills learned late.
dialogue.zh: 竅門只是晚一點才學會的技巧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tile looks gray, not blue.
dialogue.zh: 這塊試片看起來是灰的，不是藍的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry tiles always look lighter than fired.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ˈtaɪlz ˈɔlweɪz lʊk ˈlaɪtər ðæn ˈfaɪərd/
dialogue.zh: 乾的試片總是比燒好的淺一色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: White clay shows on every ridge.
dialogue.zh: 每道紋路都會露出白泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ridges are yours, keep them visible.
dialogue.zh: 那些紋路是你的，要讓它們看得見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the recipe for this blue?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈrɛsəpi fɔr ðɪs blu/
dialogue.zh: 這個藍色的配方寫在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Written on the tile back, in pencil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtn ɑn ðə taɪl bæk ɪn ˈpɛnsəl/
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆寫在試片的背面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One student mixed two jars wrong.
dialogue.zh: 有個學生把兩罐釉調錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She got ten beautiful gray cups.
dialogue.zh: 她反而得到十個漂亮的灰杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she keep them all?
dialogue.zh: 她十個全都留下了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people keep everything from a kiln.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl kip ˈɛvriθɪŋ frʌm ə kɪln/
dialogue.zh: 多數人從窯裡拿出來的都不捨得丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my favorite cup cracks?
dialogue.zh: 要是我最喜歡的那個杯子裂了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Failures teach faster than successes.
dialogue.zh: 失敗教得比成功快一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks, then my shelf goes bare.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks ðɛn maɪ ʃɛlf goʊz bɛr/
dialogue.zh: 兩週過去，我的架子就空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best sound, empty shelves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst saʊnd ˈɛmpti ʃɛlvz/
dialogue.zh: 那是最好聽的聲音，空空的窯架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who opens the kiln door?
dialogue.zh: 誰會去開窯門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody but me, and only cooled.
dialogue.zh: 除了我沒人開，而且要等它完全冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trust the glaze, it does the rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst ðə ɡleɪz ɪt dʌz ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 相信那層釉，剩下的交給它？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust it, heat finishes what hands start.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst ɪt hit ˈfɪnɪʃɪz wʌt hændz stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 相信它，高熱完成雙手開始的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Satin sounds like shiny and matte mixed.
dialogue.phonetic: /sætaɪn saʊndz laɪk ˈʃaɪni ænd mæt mɪkst/
dialogue.zh: 綢光聽起來像亮面和霧面混在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Satin is soft, and very forgiving.
dialogue.zh: 綢光很柔和，而且一點也不挑剔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grease from my hands, does it matter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡris frʌm maɪ hændz dʌz ɪt ˈmætər/
dialogue.zh: 我手上的油，這件事重要嗎？
