dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash twice, right before you dip.
dialogue.zh: 就在浸釉之前，把手洗兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside or outside, which first?
dialogue.zh: 內壁和外壁，先上哪一邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside first, then pour it out.
dialogue.zh: 先上內壁，再把多的倒出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour inside? That wastes so much glaze.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔr ɪnˈsaɪd ðæt weɪsts soʊ mʌtʃ ɡleɪz/
dialogue.zh: 倒進裡面？那樣好浪費釉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bucket catches every drop back.
dialogue.zh: 下面的桶會接住每一滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coffee cup needs brown inside.
dialogue.zh: 我的咖啡杯裡面想要棕色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown inside is a safe, warm choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn ɪnˈsaɪd ɪz ə seɪf wɔrm tʃɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 裡面燒棕色是個安全又溫暖的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can two glazes share one cup?
dialogue.zh: 兩種釉可以共用一個杯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two glazes need one careful dip.
dialogue.zh: 兩種釉就只有一次小心的浸釉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful how? Say it again, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 小心是指哪邊？再說一次，慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Level, slow, no waving your arm.
dialogue.zh: 端平、慢、手不要亂揮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kitchen light makes my blue look gray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃən laɪt meɪks maɪ blu lʊk ɡreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 家裡的燈光讓我的藍看起來發灰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daylight is honest, use the window.
dialogue.zh: 日光最誠實，拿去窗邊看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line around the base looks designed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn əˈraʊnd ðə beɪs lʊks dɪˈzaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 底下一圈細線看起來像故意設計的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That line is the whole plan, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪn ɪz ðə hoʊl plæn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 既然有那條線，整件事就是設計了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sticky wax, and the brush won't clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪki wæks ænd ðə brʌʃ woʊnt klin/
dialogue.zh: 蠟黏黏的，筆也洗不起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the wax brush near the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə wæks brʌʃ nɪr ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 上蠟的筆要放在燈的旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm wax brushes easier, I see.
dialogue.zh: 溫熱的蠟比較好刷，我懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm anything is easier in winter.
dialogue.zh: 冬天裡，東西溫了就好做事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much glaze for one small cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɡleɪz fɔr wʌn smɔl kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 一個小杯子要用掉多少釉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dip, and a brush for the foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn dɪp ænd ə brʌʃ fɔr ðə fʊt/
dialogue.zh: 浸一次，杯足再用筆補一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glaze costs extra per piece, right?
dialogue.zh: 釉要另外按件收費，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars each, any color you pick.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdɑlərz itʃ ˈɛni ˈkʌlər ju pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 一件兩元，顏色隨便你挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I choose the deep ocean blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ tʃuːz ðə dip ˈoʊʃən blu/
dialogue.zh: 那我選深海藍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ocean on white clay, very sharp.
dialogue.zh: 深藍配白泥，對比很俐落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sharp or soft, which suits my cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑrp ɔr sɔft wɪtʃ suts maɪ kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 俐落還是柔和，哪個適合我的杯子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft blue, since your hands are steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft blu sɪns jʊr hændz ɑr ˈstɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 柔和的藍吧，因為你的手很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaf stamp, or just the plain blue?
dialogue.phonetic: /lif stæmp ɔr dʒʌst ðə pleɪn blu/
dialogue.zh: 要壓樹葉印，還是就純藍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue with one leaf, no more than that.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu wɪð wʌn lif noʊ mɔr ðæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 藍加一片葉子，不要再多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, my cup wears one blue coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn maɪ kʌp wɛrz wʌn blu koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 好了，我的杯子穿上一層藍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second firing takes two weeks.
dialogue.zh: 第二次燒製要兩個禮拜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks passed, my phone says today.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks pæst maɪ foʊn sɛz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個禮拜過去了，我手機上寫今天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today is pickup, four to eight.
dialogue.zh: 今天是取件日，四點到八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is six the busiest hour?
dialogue.zh: 六點是不是最忙的時段？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is crowded, come earlier please.
dialogue.zh: 六點人很多，請早一點過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I look on the shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ lʊk ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 我在架子上要往哪裡找？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shelf C, second row, find your tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛlf si ˈsɛkənd roʊ faɪnd jʊr teɪp/
dialogue.zh: 第三層、第二排，先找到你的膠帶名條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tape name has faded away.
dialogue.zh: 我名條上的字都褪掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Match the initials and your small leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /mætʃ ði ɪˈnɪʃəlz ænd jʊr smɔl lif/
dialogue.zh: 對姓名縮寫，還有你那片小葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shelf holds hundreds of pots.
dialogue.zh: 這個架子上有幾百個坯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hundred ten, waiting, all glazed.
dialogue.zh: 兩百一十件，都在等，全都上了釉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found mine, but this base ring split.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd maɪn bʌt ðɪs beɪs rɪŋ splɪt/
dialogue.zh: 找到我的了，可是這個底圈裂開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dried too fast, kiln heat is steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt draɪd tu fæst kɪln hit ɪz ˈstɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 它乾得太快了，窯的溫度倒是很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the split is my fault, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə splɪt ɪz maɪ fɔlt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以裂開是我自己的錯，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, clay argues with every new maker.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kleɪ ˈɑrɡjuːz wɪð ˈɛvri nju ˈmeɪkər/
dialogue.zh: 不，泥巴跟每個新手都會吵架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get money back for cracked ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ˈmʌni bæk fɔr krækt wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 裂掉的那幾件可以退錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Refund covers glaze only, or store credit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrifʌnd ˈkʌvərz ɡleɪz ˈoʊnli ɔr stɔr ˈkrɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 退款只算釉的錢，不然就是店內折抵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Store credit means another class, right?
dialogue.zh: 店內折抵就是再上一堂課，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the handle class is in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə ˈhændəl klæs ɪz ɪn mɑrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對，做把手的課在三月上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Handles, spouts, lids, all in one class?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhændəlz spaʊts lɪdz ɔl ɪn wʌn klæs/
dialogue.zh: 把手、壺嘴、壺蓋，一堂課全都學？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lids fit by luck, honestly speaking.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，壺蓋合不合要看運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many of my nine survived?
dialogue.zh: 我那九件裡，活了幾件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six came out whole, that is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks keɪm aʊt hoʊl ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 六件完好地出窯，這已經很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plenty? Beginners usually keep fewer.
dialogue.zh: 很多嗎？剛開始學的人通常留更少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four out of nine, that is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr aʊt ʌv naɪn ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 九件裡剩四件，這很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blue cup ran deeper than planned.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ blu kʌp ræn ˈdiːpər ðæn plænd/
dialogue.zh: 我的藍杯子顏色比預定的深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deeper blue still wears your name.
dialogue.zh: 再深的藍，上面也還刻著你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The name is crisp, every stroke.
dialogue.zh: 名字很清楚，每一筆都看得見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crisp carving is your prettiest work here.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɪsp ˈkɑrvɪŋ ɪz jʊr ˈprɪtiəst wɜrk hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 刻得清楚，是你在這兒最漂亮的成績。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any cracked rim in the box?
dialogue.zh: 盒子裡有裂口的杯緣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cracked rim, but a drip on one side.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ krækt rɪm bʌt ə drɪp ɑn wʌn saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 杯緣沒裂，但有一邊留了一道釉痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A drip? Is that a mistake?
dialogue.zh: 流釉？那算做錯了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is accidental beauty, our motto.
dialogue.zh: 那叫意外的漂亮，是我們工作室的口號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say that again, accidental beauty.
dialogue.zh: 請再說一次，意外的漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every pot keeps one honest accident.
dialogue.zh: 每一個壺都留著一次老實的意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Box it with paper, two layers.
dialogue.zh: 用紙箱裝，杯子包兩層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two layers per cup, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈleɪərz pɜr kʌp ðæt ɪz ðə rul/
dialogue.zh: 一個杯子兩層紙，這是我們的規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they chip on the drive home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðeɪ tʃɪp ɑn ðə draɪv hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 開車回家的路上會撞缺角嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing chips unless the car does.
dialogue.zh: 除非車子撞了，否則不會缺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do all six fit in one tote?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɔl sɪks fɪt ɪn wʌn toʊt/
dialogue.zh: 六件都裝得進一個提袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the receipt is inside already.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə rɪˈsit ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 可以，收據已經放在袋子裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glaze is two dollars per piece?
dialogue.zh: 釉是一件兩元嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six pieces, twelve, card is easiest.
dialogue.zh: 六件十二元，刷卡最省事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tax on a hobby, thankfully.
dialogue.zh: 這只是嗜好，居然不用加稅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is a class, not a business.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ə klæs nɑt ə ˈbɪznəs/
dialogue.zh: 我們是在上課，不是在做生意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three seats left for the next term.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri sits lɛft fɔr ðə nɛkst tɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 下一期只剩三個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay tonight and I hold your stool.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ təˈnaɪt ænd aɪ hoʊld jʊr stuːl/
dialogue.zh: 今晚繳錢，我就替你留著那張凳子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wheel eight is mine every week now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil eɪt ɪz maɪn ˈɛvri wik naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 八號拉坯機現在每個星期都是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight is yours, nobody else wants it.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɪz jʊrz ˈnoʊbədi ɛls wɑnts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 八號就是你的，沒有別人想搶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two months in and I still wobble.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌnθs ɪn ænd aɪ stɪl ˈwɑbəl/
dialogue.zh: 上了兩個月，我的坯還是會搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wobble goes when your hips stay low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑbəl ɡoʊz wɛn jʊr hɪps steɪ loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你坐低不動，搖晃自己就會走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea tastes different in a clay cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti teɪsts ˈdɪfərənt ɪn ə kleɪ kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 茶用陶杯裝，味道不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warmer, earthier, and sipped much slower.
dialogue.zh: 更溫、更帶土香，而且喝得慢很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Earthier is a word for wet mud?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜrðiər ɪz ə wɜrd fɔr wɛt mʌd/
dialogue.zh: 比較像土，是用來形容濕泥的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mud is wet, earth is fired and dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌd ɪz wɛt ɜrθ ɪz ˈfaɪərd ænd draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 泥是濕的，土是燒乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a card for each student.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə kɑrd fɔr itʃ ˈstudənt/
dialogue.zh: 每位學員都有一張自己的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your card lists every piece you made.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr kɑrd lɪsts ˈɛvri pis ju meɪd/
dialogue.zh: 你做的每一件都記在你的卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine made, six left, the card says.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn meɪd sɪks lɛft ðə kɑrd sɛz/
dialogue.zh: 卡上寫著：做了九件，剩六件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is a shelf, not a failure.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ə ʃɛlf nɑt ə ˈfeɪljər/
dialogue.zh: 六件夠擺一個架子了，那不是失敗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parking, is the street side still free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrkɪŋ ɪz ðə strit saɪd stɪl fri/
dialogue.zh: 路邊那一排停車位還免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free after seven, drive in slowly.
dialogue.zh: 七點以後免費，開進來慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the blue one with the leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə blu wʌn wɪð ðə lif/
dialogue.zh: 我要那個帶葉子的藍杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The leaf cup suits your own shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lif kʌp suts jʊr oʊn ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 那片葉子杯很配你自己家裡的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning tea, blue cup, quiet shelf.
dialogue.zh: 早上的茶、藍杯子、安靜的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Matches the shelf and the morning light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmætʃɪz ðə ʃɛlf ænd ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 跟架子配，也跟晨光配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dirty apron again, on purpose now.
dialogue.zh: 圍裙又髒了，這一次是我甘願的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean aprons never made anything good.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的圍裙從來沒做出好東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time next term, then?
dialogue.zh: 那下一期還是同一個時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday, six, wheel eight, apron hook.
dialogue.zh: 星期二、六點、八號機、圍裙鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring my own tools next?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ maɪ oʊn tuːlz nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 下次我該帶自己的工具嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the tray tools teach first.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ðə treɪ tuːlz titʃ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 還不用，盤子裡那些工具先教你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray is mine now, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ ɪz maɪn naʊ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我覺得那個工具盤是我的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shared tray, shared clay, shared mistakes.
dialogue.zh: 共用的盤、共用的泥、共用的錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, can I watch firing?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ kæn aɪ wɑtʃ ˈfaɪərɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，我能看燒窯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Opening day, bring a friend, come early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpənɪŋ deɪ brɪŋ ə frɛnd kʌm ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 開窯那天，帶個朋友來，早一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How hot was this firing, finally?
dialogue.zh: 這一窯最後燒到多高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too hot for hands, that is the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hɑt fɔr hændz ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 對雙手來說太燙了，重點就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks feels long for six cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks filz lɔŋ fɔr sɪks kʌps/
dialogue.zh: 六個杯子要等兩週，覺得好久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waiting is part of the craft, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪtɪŋ ɪz pɑrt ʌv ðə kræft ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 等待本來就是手藝的一部分，可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend says pottery is just patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd sɛz ˈpɑtəri ɪz dʒʌst ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友說，陶藝不過就是耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patience plus very dirty shoes, exactly.
dialogue.zh: 耐心再加一雙很髒的鞋，就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipt, box, tote, and my keys.
dialogue.zh: 收據、紙箱、提袋，還有我的鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All yours, one careful trip to the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl jʊrz wʌn ˈkɛrfəl trɪp tu ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 全是你的了，慢慢走一趟到車邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave the cracked one here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ liv ðə krækt wʌn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 裂掉的那一件我能留在這兒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It thuds, so leave it; we grind it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt θʌdz soʊ liv ɪt wi ɡraɪnd ɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 它敲起來發悶，所以留下吧，我們會把它磨回泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broken pots feed the next pots, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbroʊkən pɑts fid ðə nɛkst pɑts ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以破掉的壺要養著下一批壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the circle of this studio.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈsɜrkəl ʌv ðɪs ˈstuːdioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這就是這間工作室的循環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next class I want a tall vase.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst klæs aɪ wɑnt ə tɔl veɪs/
dialogue.zh: 下一堂課我想要一個高花瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tall vases need a very calm week.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔl ˈveɪsəz nid ə ˈvɛri kɑm wik/
dialogue.zh: 高花瓶需要一個非常平靜的星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calm weeks are rare in this city.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑm wiːks ɑr rɛr ɪn ðɪs ˈsɪti/
dialogue.zh: 在這個城市裡，平靜的星期很少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wheel does not care about traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wil dʌz nɑt kɛr əˈbaʊt ˈtræfɪk/
dialogue.zh: 拉坯機才不管外面塞不塞車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the wheel ignores my whole week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə wil ˌɪɡˈnɔrz maɪ hoʊl wik/
dialogue.zh: 真好，拉坯機對我一整週不聞不問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It only knows today, and your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊnli noʊz təˈdeɪ ænd jʊr hændz/
dialogue.zh: 它只認得今天，還有你的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then Tuesday, hands first, thinking later.
dialogue.zh: 那就到星期二，手先到，腦子後到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the apron, the hook is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ði ˈeɪprən ðə hʊk ɪz jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 把圍裙帶來，那個鉤子還是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you Tuesday, teacher, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 週二見，老師，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Tuesday, wet clay, warm water.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈtuzdeɪ wɛt kleɪ wɔrm ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 週二見，濕的泥、溫的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last look, my shelf is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst lʊk maɪ ʃɛlf ɪz ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 最後看一眼，我的架子空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty shelf means another one fills soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti ʃɛlf minz əˈnʌðər wʌn fɪlz sun/
dialogue.zh: 架子空了，表示很快又會滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday night, apron, wheel, and clay.
dialogue.zh: 星期二晚上，圍裙、拉坯機，還有泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday night, same time, same warm sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ naɪt seɪm taɪm seɪm wɔrm sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 星期二晚上，同一個時間，同一盆溫水。
